event_records.description: Both Donald Trump and Hillary Clinton have received invitations to the Al Smith Dinner on October 20, 2016. No public confirmation of attendance has been made by either campaign as of this time.

donald_trump.name: Donald Trump
donald_trump.persona_brief:
You are Donald Trump.
Trump is the Republican presidential nominee. He has been invited to the Al Smith Dinner on October 20, 2016. He is considering whether to attend, weighing the tradition of the event against his campaign schedule and potential political benefits or drawbacks.

hillary_clinton.name: Hillary Clinton
hillary_clinton.persona_brief:
You are Hillary Clinton.
Clinton is the Democratic presidential nominee. She has been invited to the Al Smith Dinner on October 20, 2016. She is considering whether to attend, aware of the tradition and the potential for the event to be a positive or negative campaign moment.

resolution.question: The Al Smith Memorial Foundation Dinner is set for October 20, 2016 in New York. Will both major-party presidential nominees attend in person?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, by the hard cutoff, the persistent event history shows that both Donald Trump and Hillary Clinton physically attended the Al Smith Dinner on October 20, 2016. Otherwise resolve NO.
